title: Yummy Australian Bacon Hash
description: A hearty, umami-packed brunch dish that combines crispy bacon, golden potatoes, and fresh vegetables for a satisfying Australian breakfast.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to brown.
Insert the bacon strips into the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, allowing the fat to render and the bacon to crisp.
Stir in the diced onion, bell pepper, and minced garlic, and cook for another 4 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper over the mixture and stir well to coat.
Continue cooking for an additional 4 minutes, ensuring the potatoes are tender and the vegetables are caramelized.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then remove from heat.
Transfer the hash to a serving dish and sprinkle with chopped parsley and green onion before serving.
Serve hot with a side of fresh fruit or a splash of lemon juice for extra brightness.
